conviction_note: I rebuilt the missing reaction history: the last print (24 Jun 2026, same amc-release/next-morning-call structure as tonight) moved the stock +37.5% in one session and the March 2026 print moved it about -10% then -12% again, so the baseline's 7.4% event-implied move materially understates this name's earnings-day distribution and every band below is deliberately wide. Within that wide distribution I lean down ~60/40 for one reason that is arithmetic rather than opinion: the entire $19.6M sequential jump in Q4 FY26 adjusted EBITDA that caused the +37.5% re-rating is accounted for by ~$19M of one-time EV-programme customer recoveries, Q1 FY27 is the first quarter without them AND the quarter management pre-announced as seasonally light, and the stock has still added another +16.5% in the five sessions since the Craig-Hallum initiation on no company news at all.

findings.finding: Q4 FY26 adjusted EBITDA of $26.9M (9.0% margin) versus Q3 FY26's $7.3M (3.1% margin) is a $19.6M sequential jump that is almost exactly the ~$19M of one-time EV customer recoveries management said flowed through to earnings; ex-recoveries Q4 margin was ~2.9%, i.e. flat with Q3, and the FY27 guide of $72-82M adj EBITDA is therefore +47% to +67% off a recovery-adjusted FY26 base of ~$49M, not the +6% to +20% the headline $68.2M comparison implies.
findings.why_not_priced: The wire framing of the June print is 'net sales up 15.9%, topped estimates by 25%, adjusted EBITDA beat by nearly 60%' with no adjustment for the $22.5M of recoveries, and the stock's +140% YTD re-rating was built on that framing. If the market had done this arithmetic, Baird's post-print $16 target (raised 26 Jun) would be the marginal price rather than 17% below spot, the average target would not sit at $22 with the stock at $18.9, and you would not see four consecutive up days into a quarter the company itself pre-announced as light. The recoveries are disclosed, but with only three or four analysts covering the name and one of them initiating a week ago at $30, nobody has been forced to publish the recovery-adjusted run rate.
findings.independence: The Q3 FY26 press release is a separate document from a separate quarter and independently establishes the underlying run rate at $7.3M adjusted EBITDA on $233.7M of sales, 3.1% margin - https://ir.methode.com/news/news-details/2026/Methode-Electronics-Inc--Reports-Fiscal-2026-Third-Quarter-Financial-Results/default.aspx (2026-03-05). Note the $22.5M revenue figure and the $19M earnings flow-through / 'lighter first quarter' quote come from the same June 24-25 print cluster (8-K exhibit 99.1 and the 25 Jun call transcript, https://uk.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-methode-electronics-tops-q4-2026-estimates-shares-jump-93CH-4744955), so treat those two as one source.

findings.finding: The +16.5% five-session run-up happened entirely AFTER the only piece of news: Craig-Hallum's initiation moved the stock +14.9% on 2026-08-25 to $16.05, and it then closed up four straight sessions (~17.06, 17.78, 18.23, 18.32, 18.705) on rising volume with no company release in that window other than the 26 Aug earnings-date notice - leaving spot above Baird's $16 target and at 86% of the $22 average target going into a quarter the company guided to be the seasonally weak one.
findings.why_not_priced: The baseline carries the run-up as a single number; what it cannot show is that none of the last 16.5% has any informational content behind it. The release is after tonight's close and the call is not until 08:00 ET tomorrow, so the first-session reaction is priced off the press release alone - which can contain the Q1 numbers and a guidance line, but structurally cannot contain the 800V rack-architecture narrative that management explicitly excluded from guidance and that the last four sessions have been buying. If the market had priced that mechanic, the put skew would be concentrated in the front expiry rather than sitting at a generic +14 vol points on a 106% IV momentum small cap, and the melt-up would not have run into the print unchecked.
findings.independence: Separate source, separate date: the analyst target structure (Baird Neutral $16 raised 26 Jun, Barrington Outperform $25, Craig-Hallum Buy $30, average $22, average rating Hold) plus Q1 FY27 consensus of $(0.27) EPS on $238.0M revenue against Q4's reported $298.1M - https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/upcoming-methode-electronics-mei-to-release-quarterly-earnings-on-wednesday-2026-08-28/ (2026-08-28). Short interest is only ~5% of float and falling, so there is no squeeze bid to offset the long positioning.

findings.finding: SemiAnalysis's deep supply-chain teardown of the 800VDC rack transition does not mention Methode Electronics anywhere, and names TE Connectivity for the standardized busbars in the Diablo 400 specification alongside Delta, ABB, Legrand and EAE for 800VDC distribution.
findings.why_not_priced: MEI has been repriced 140% YTD as an 800VDC beneficiary while the most-read primary-research account of exactly that transition, published three weeks before the guidance that triggered the re-rating, does not have the company in the supply chain at all. If the market had weighed this, the data-centre line would be valued as the disclosed $130M busbar run-rate rather than as an option on the 800V rack, and the stock would not need the 'not included in guidance, could provide upside later' bucket to justify $18.9. Caveat I am pricing in: Methode's product is in-rack laminated busbar, not busway, so the absence is suggestive rather than dispositive - hence the small size.

searched_and_found_nothing: Copper as an unpriced input shock: copper is +43.7% year-on-year and set an all-time COMEX high of ~$6.83/lb in August 2026 (https://tradingeconomics.com/commodity/copper, 2026-09-02), and Methode's own 10-K says short-term raw-material increases 'can be very difficult to fully offset with price increases because of contractual agreements with its customers'. I dropped it: LME copper actually peaked in January 2026 (https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/commodities/articles/copper-price-hits-time-high-142138611.html, 2026-08-06 - August was near but below the January record), and Methode set FY27 guidance on 24 June 2026 with roughly 60% of Q1 already in the books and copper already at record levels, so this is in guidance rather than incremental.

The 2026 Iran war / Strait of Hormuz closure (28 Feb - 7 Apr 2026), $126 Brent and the resulting Gulf aluminium shortage and production cuts at Toyota, VW and the Detroit three - all of it predates the 24 June guidance, so it is guided, not new (https://www.automotivemanufacturingsolutions.com/analysis/iran-war-strikes-at-the-factory-floor/2634296)

A post-24-June downgrade to North American light-vehicle production that management could not have known: the sharpest-decline-in-five-years piece that surfaced turned out to be dated 2025-10-28 (modified 2026-01-06), not a 2026 H2 revision

Insider signal: all four August Form 4s (CEO DeGaynor 47,268 sh, CFO Kowalchik 11,268, Thomas 4,068, GC Vyverberg 4,327, all 2026-08-08 at $16.67) are RSU tax withholding to the issuer, not open-market sales - no cluster

A quiet 8-K, covenant amendment or credit-agreement exhibit since the print: EDGAR shows nothing on CIK 0000065270 after the 2026-06-24 8-K/10-K except Form 4s and the 31 July proxy (https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0000065270)
The DEF 14A filed 2026-07-31 for the 16 Sep 2026 annual meeting: the CD&A section would not render, so I could not read FY26 incentive achievement or any FY27 internal targets

A new data-centre design win, programme award or capacity announcement in the ten weeks since the last print - nothing on the company IR newsroom, in GlobeNewswire, or in trade press; for a story stock that is a mildly negative absence but too soft to size
Short interest as a squeeze setup: ~1.28M shares, ~5% of float and declining, ~2 days to cover - not a factor

A supplier or customer that guided after Methode last spoke and points at the data-centre busbar line specifically (Vertiv, Eaton, nVent, Amphenol commentary) - nothing dated after 2026-06-24 that I could tie to Methode's content
Hiring-page signal: 24 US openings, nothing that reads as a whole team added or deleted in power solutions
baseline_tension: My lean agrees with the +14.23 vol point put skew, which is a mark against it - but it cuts hard against the run-up, and it cuts against the baseline's 7.4% implied event move, because the reaction history the baseline is missing (+37.5% on 2026-06-25, roughly -10% then -12% on the March 2026 print) says this name's earnings-day distribution is two to three times wider than the front-expiry decomposition implies in both directions.
